# stb_truetype, vendored

The text layer (`text/`, PORT-014) draws its English with
[stb_truetype](https://github.com/nothings/stb) by Sean Barrett, public
domain or MIT as the user chooses (`LICENSE`). `stb_truetype.h` is v1.26,
from commit `2c980bb59875b0d32144a71867fbdebb2f77cd20`, copied unchanged.
`text/tl_font.c` compiles its implementation.
